attachments.name: SureFire M600DF Game Ready Flashlight
attachments.description:
This is a real-time, game-ready model of the iconic SureFire Scout tactical flashlight.
The asset was created as part of my hard-surface practice and optimized for use in modern game engines such as Unreal Engine 5 and Unity HDRP.

The high-poly was modeled and detailed in Blender, baked onto a clean low-poly mesh, and textured using a full PBR workflow (Substance Painter → Marmoset Toolbag).
All renders and the turntable here are displayed using Sketchfab’s real-time PBR renderer.

• Technical Details

Tris count: 12,146
Texture sets: 1× 4K
Maps: Albedo, Roughness, Metallic, Normal (DirectX/OpenGL), Ambient Occlusion
Workflow: Metallic/Roughness
Low Poly: Blender
High Poly: Blender
Bake: Marmoset Toolbag
Texture: Substance Painter
Engine Test: Unreal Engine 5

• Features

Clean and optimized topology
High-quality normal map bake
Custom brushed aluminium material
Realistic micro-detail (knurling, roughness breakup, subtle wear)
Accurate proportions based on real reference
